subject: planner/core: fix leading hint mismatch causing missing other conditions (#65956)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent, focusing on planner join reorder + LEADING hint handling. The change in `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_reorder.go` snapshots `baseSingleGroupJoinOrderSolver.otherConds` before attempting to build the hinted join tree and restores it when the hint is deemed inapplicable, preventing loss of non-equi/other predicates if hint processing partially consumes conditions then fails. Added regression test in `pkg/planner/core/casetest/rule/rule_join_reorder_test.go` asserts the `t2_lh.k1 < t3_lh.k2` predicate remains visible in the plan and that an inapplicable-leading warning is produced.
